config.label: Backend origin hosting the /mcp endpoint
config.description: Backend origin hosting the /mcp endpoint. Defaults to Reel Estate production (https://api.tryreelestate.com); set to a staging or self-hosted backend to override.

config.label: Public OAuth client id (PKCE, no secret)
config.description: Public OAuth client id (PKCE, no secret). Auto-selected per backend host by default; set only when pointing at a backend on a different Clerk instance.

config.label: Loopback port the browser is redirected to after sign-in
config.description: Loopback port the browser is redirected to after sign-in. Defaults to 8765.

config.label: Directory where OAuth tokens are cached
config.description: Directory where OAuth tokens are cached. Defaults to ~/.reel-estate-mcp.

config.label: Optional OAuth scope override
config.description: Optional OAuth scope override. Omitted by default (negotiated from server metadata).

config.label: Set to 1/true to block all mutating (non-GET) tool calls
config.description: Set to 1/true to block all mutating (non-GET) tool calls.
